title: Measures to Protect Singaporeans from Zika Virus
what_it_is: Measures to Protect Singaporeans from Zika Virus

sections.label: WHO Zika emergency declaration
sections.summary: On 1 February 2016, WHO declared Brazil's microcephaly and neurological disorder cluster a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: On 1 February 2016, the World Health Organization (WHO) declared the recent cluster of microcephaly cases and other neurological disorders reported in Brazil a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

sections.label: Zika added to notifiable diseases
sections.summary: Since 26 January this year, Zika virus infection has been added to the List of Notifiable Infectious Diseases under the Infectious Diseases Act.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Since 26 January this year, Zika virus infection has been added to the List of Notifiable Infectious Diseases under the Infectious Diseases Act.

sections.label: Blood donor deferral and surveillance
sections.summary: HSA requires donors with travel history to outbreak areas to be deferred 28 days, and WHO-recommended surveillance for microcephaly and Guillain-Barre Syndrome has been enhanced.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In addition, the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) has also required that donors with a history of travel to outbreak areas be deferred from donating blood for 28 days upon return.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As recommended by WHO, surveillance for microcephaly and Guillain-Barre Syndrome (GBS) has been enhanced to pick up any unusual trends.

sections.label: Clinical advisory group for pregnant women
sections.summary: MOH set up a clinical advisory group on managing pregnant women with confirmed or suspected Zika, and will issue guidelines to doctors based on its recommendations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: MOH has set up a clinical advisory group to provide assessment and advice on the clinical management of pregnant women with confirmed or suspected Zika virus infection.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: MOH will issue guidelines and recommendations to doctors based on the recommendations of the advisory group.

sections.label: Subsidised ultrasound screening
sections.summary: Currently, subsidised patients in public hospitals will be able to receive subsidised ultrasound screening.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to ultrasound scans and whether they will be given free, just let me say that, currently, subsidised patients in public hospitals will be able to receive subsidised ultrasound screening.

sections.label: Isolation then mitigation measures
sections.summary: MOH will isolate confirmed Zika cases to reduce community transmission, but will move from containment to mitigation measures once community spread occurs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: MOH will isolate confirmed cases Page: 28 of Zika infection to reduce the risk of transmission in the community.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But once there is community spread – that is, if the Zika virus takes root and infection takes root in the community – then we will move from containment to mitigation measures.
